sloka: उद्योगः तु चिर आज्ञप्तः सुग्रीवेण नरोत्तम ।काम्स्य अपि विधेयेन तव अर्थ प्रति साधने ॥४-३३-५९॥
transliteration: udyogaḥ tu cira ājñaptaḥ sugrīveṇa narottama ।kāmsya api vidheyena tava artha prati sādhane ॥4-33-59॥

translations.english: 'O best of men although overpowered by sense pleasures, Sugriva has already initiated efforts for the accomplishment of your work.
